sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已上线，您可以在任何收听播客的平台上找到它。

sentences.en: On the 29th of January 1999, best friends Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman had a sleepover at Ashley's house to celebrate her 16th birthday.
sentences.zh: 1999年1月29日，好朋友劳拉·拜伯和阿什莉·弗里曼在阿什莉家过夜，庆祝她16岁的生日。

sentences.en: Ashley's parents, Danny and Kathy Freeman, were also at the house, which was actually a trailer on a rural property in Welsh, located in Craig County, Oklahoma, USA.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉的父母丹尼和凯西·弗里曼也在家中，那其实是位于美国俄克拉荷马州克雷格县威尔士地区一处乡村房产上的拖车屋。

sentences.en: It was a remote area.
sentences.zh: 那是一个偏远地区。

sentences.en: It was a pretty quiet, uneventful night of eating cake and watching TV.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相当安静、平淡的夜晚，她们吃着蛋糕，看着电视。

sentences.en: Nothing seemed out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 一切看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: But about 6am the next morning, a neighbour reported that the Freeman house was on fire.
sentences.zh: 但第二天清晨6点左右，一位邻居报警称弗里曼家着火了。

sentences.en: Emergency services rushed to the scene and found the body of Kathy Freeman.
sentences.zh: 紧急救援人员赶到现场，发现了凯西·弗里曼的遗体。

sentences.en: But where were Danny, Laura and Ashley?
sentences.zh: 但丹尼、劳拉和阿什莉去哪儿了呢？

sentences.en: Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman grew up in Veneta, a town in Craig County, Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·拜伯和阿什莉·弗里曼在俄克拉荷马州克雷格县的维内塔镇长大。

sentences.en: The population at the time was about 6,500 people.
sentences.zh: 当时的人口大约有6500人。

sentences.en: Laura was born on the 18th of April 1983.
sentences.zh: 劳拉出生于1983年4月18日。

sentences.en: Ashley was born later that year, on the 29th of December 1983.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉出生于同年晚些时候，即1983年12月29日。

sentences.en: Laura and Ashley first met each other in kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和阿什莉在幼儿园第一次见面。

sentences.en: They formed an instant bond and were basically inseparable ever since.
sentences.zh: 她们一见如故，从那以后几乎形影不离。

sentences.en: They only got closer as time went on and were the best of friends.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，她们的关系愈发亲密，成了最好的朋友。

sentences.en: About as close as friends could get.
sentences.zh: 好到不能再好的那种朋友。

sentences.en: Lauren Bible, Laura's mother, says that Laura and Ashley would call each other at least once a week.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的母亲劳伦·拜伯说，劳拉和阿什莉至少每周会通一次电话。

sentences.en: What one was thinking, the other was thinking.
sentences.zh: 一个人的想法，另一个人也能想到。

sentences.en: When one of them started a sentence, the other one would be able to finish it.
sentences.zh: 当其中一人开始说话，另一人就能接上话茬。

sentences.en: They attended the same schools and spent every waking minute together throughout their early school years.
sentences.zh: 她们上同一所学校，在早年的求学时光里，她们每分每秒都待在一起。

sentences.en: But then in 1995, Ashley's parents decided to make the move to Welsh,
sentences.zh: 但到了1995年，阿什莉的父母决定搬到威尔士。

sentences.en: Welsh, still in Craig County, Oklahoma, about 32 kilometres away, or 20 miles.
sentences.zh: 威尔士同样位于俄克拉荷马州的克雷格县，距离约32公里，也就是20英里。

sentences.en: Welsh was a rural area with a population of about 600 at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时的威尔士是一个人口约600人的乡村地区。

sentences.en: The Freemans moved into a trailer on a rural property that they owned, which was about 40 acres in size.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家搬进了一辆拖车屋，位于他们拥有的一处约40英亩的乡村房产上。

sentences.en: It was a pretty isolated, remote, quiet spot.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相当孤立、偏远且安静的地方。

sentences.en: It was a testing time for the girls' friendship, but they got through it.
sentences.zh: 这对女孩们的友谊是一次考验，但她们挺过来了。

sentences.en: They remained best of friends and still managed to see each other quite regularly.
sentences.zh: 她们依然是最好的朋友，并且仍然设法定期见面。

sentences.en: They called each other on the phone almost daily.
sentences.zh: 她们几乎每天都会通电话。

sentences.en: Laura and Ashley were your typical teenage girls.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和阿什莉就是典型的青春期女孩。

sentences.en: They loved hair, make-up, shopping, clothes, the usual stuff.
sentences.zh: 她们喜欢发型、化妆、购物、衣服，这些寻常的东西。

sentences.en: Both were also very good students and they were in the top 10% of their classes.
sentences.zh: 两人也都是非常优秀的学生，成绩都在班级前10%。

sentences.en: Laura was a cheerleader and had a passion and love for animals.
sentences.zh: 劳拉是啦啦队员，对动物充满热情和爱心。

sentences.en: Ashley was more of an athletic type and she was in the basketball team.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉则更具运动天赋，她是篮球队的成员。

sentences.en: She loved hunting as well.
sentences.zh: 她也热爱打猎。

sentences.en: She shot her first deer around the age of 12.
sentences.zh: 她在12岁左右就射杀了第一头鹿。

sentences.en: Ashley also had a job at a local convenience store and she hoped to save enough money by the time she turned 16 to buy a car.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉还在当地一家便利店打工，她希望在16岁生日时能攒够钱买一辆车。

sentences.en: Ashley's mother, Kathy Freeman, was described as a loving and caring person.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉的母亲凯西·弗里曼被描述为一个充满爱心和关怀的人。

sentences.en: She was a hard worker and was the main breadwinner for the family.
sentences.zh: 她工作勤奋，是家里的主要经济支柱。

sentences.en: Her father, Danny Freeman, he was known to have a little bit of a violent temper.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲丹尼·弗里曼，以脾气暴躁而闻名。

sentences.en: Ashley also had an older brother, Shane.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉还有一个哥哥，名叫肖恩。

sentences.en: He was three years older than her.
sentences.zh: 他比她大三岁。

sentences.en: And after moving to Welsh, there were a few issues starting to happen in the Freeman household.
sentences.zh: 搬到威尔士后，弗里曼家中开始出现一些问题。

sentences.en: There were reports of friction between Ashley and her father.
sentences.zh: 有报道称阿什莉和她父亲之间存在摩擦。

sentences.en: Not only that, there was friction between her father and her brother.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，她父亲和她哥哥之间也有摩擦。

sentences.en: But in 1998, Shane ran away from home.
sentences.zh: 1998年，肖恩离家出走。

sentences.en: Danny rang the local sheriff's office to report Shane missing and they located him shortly after.
sentences.zh: 丹尼打电话给当地警长办公室报告肖恩失踪，他们很快就找到了他。

sentences.en: But Shane had injuries.
sentences.zh: 但肖恩身上有伤。

sentences.en: He reported to the local deputy that he had run away because his father had whipped him for disobeying him.
sentences.zh: 他告诉当地副警长，他离家出走是因为父亲因他不听话而鞭打他。

sentences.en: And his injuries were significant enough that there was bleeding coming through his underwear.
sentences.zh: 他的伤势很严重，甚至内裤都渗出了血迹。

sentences.en: As a result, Danny Freeman was charged with assaulting Shane and a court date was set for the next year in 1999.
sentences.zh: 结果，丹尼·弗里曼被控袭击肖恩，法院定于次年，即1999年开庭审理。

sentences.en: But about four months later, on January 8th, 1999, the Freeman household would be devastated.
sentences.zh: 但大约四个月后，即1999年1月8日，弗里曼一家遭遇了毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: Shane had started to develop a bit of a taste for theft.
sentences.zh: 肖恩开始染上偷窃的恶习。

sentences.en: And on January 8th, 1999, he stole his neighbor's vehicle and a gun.
sentences.zh: 1999年1月8日，他偷了邻居的车和一把枪。

sentences.en: A little while later, Deputy David Hayes from Craig County Sheriff's Department spotted the vehicle on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，克雷格县警长办公室的副警长戴维·海耶斯在路边发现了那辆车。

sentences.en: He made his approach.
sentences.zh: 他走上前去。

sentences.en: He pulled up and got out.
sentences.zh: 他停下车并走了出来。

sentences.en: But almost immediately, Shane confronted him and pulled a gun.
sentences.zh: 但几乎立刻，肖恩就与他发生对峙并掏出了一把枪。

sentences.en: Deputy Hayes drew his gun and screamed at Shane to drop it.
sentences.zh: 海耶斯副警长拔出枪，大声喝令肖恩放下武器。

sentences.en: Shane refused, forcing Deputy Hayes to fire.
sentences.zh: 肖恩拒绝了，迫使海耶斯副警长开枪。

sentences.en: Shane died almost instantly.
sentences.zh: 肖恩当场死亡。

sentences.en: An investigation by the County District Attorney found that Deputy Hayes was acting in self-defense and the shooting was justified.
sentences.zh: 县地方检察官的调查发现，海耶斯副警长是在自卫，枪击是正当的。

sentences.en: This was devastating for the Freeman family and actually really struggled to come to terms with the death of her brother.
sentences.zh: 这对弗里曼一家来说是毁灭性的打击，他们真的很难接受哥哥去世的事实。

sentences.en: Laura played a big part in helping her friend through that tough time.
sentences.zh: 劳拉在帮助朋友度过那段艰难时期中发挥了重要作用。

sentences.en: The Freeman family refused to believe the shooting was in self-defense.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家拒绝相信枪击是出于自卫。

sentences.en: They had grave doubts about the deputy's version of events.
sentences.zh: 他们对副警长的说法深表怀疑。

sentences.en: They were of the belief it was a cold-blooded murder.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一起冷血谋杀。

sentences.en: I can't find any information as to what made the Freemans think this, if there was something in particular that led them to believe it.
sentences.zh: 我找不到任何信息说明弗里曼一家为何会有这种想法，或者是否有具体的事情导致他们这样认为。

sentences.en: But it's not unusual in cases of police shootings.
sentences.zh: 但这在警察枪击案件中并不罕见。

sentences.en: It's a natural and understandable reaction from the family to blame the police.
sentences.zh: 家人指责警察是一种自然且可以理解的反应。

sentences.en: Not their dead loved one.
sentences.zh: 而不是指责他们死去的亲人。

sentences.en: The Freeman family started to post signs around town saying, justice for Shane.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家开始在镇上张贴标语，要求“为肖恩伸张正义”。

sentences.en: They really started to make noise about it.
sentences.zh: 他们真的开始为此大造声势。

sentences.en: And as a result, a little bit of a feud started between the local sheriff's office and the Freeman family.
sentences.zh: 结果，当地警长办公室和弗里曼一家之间开始产生了一些积怨。

sentences.en: About a month after the shooting,
sentences.zh: 枪击事件发生约一个月后，

sentences.en: Danny Freeman was arrested after driving around attempting to find out where Deputy David Hayes lived.
sentences.zh: 丹尼·弗里曼因开车四处打听戴维·海耶斯副警长的住处而被捕。

sentences.en: In response to that, the local deputies started to sit outside the Freeman house in their patrol cars.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，当地副警长开始坐在巡逻车里守在弗里曼家门外。

sentences.en: The tension was starting to run away.
sentences.zh: 紧张局势开始失控。

sentences.en: Later that year, Danny still had to face court on the charge of assaulting Shane.
sentences.zh: 那年晚些时候，丹尼仍需就袭击肖恩的指控出庭受审。

sentences.en: But he was acquitted.
sentences.zh: 但他被判无罪。

sentences.en: Laura played a huge part in helping Ashley come to terms with her brother's loss throughout that year.
sentences.zh: 在这一年里，劳拉在帮助阿什莉接受哥哥离世的事实方面发挥了巨大作用。

sentences.en: And towards the end of the year, on the 29th of December, it was time to celebrate Ashley's 16th birthday.
sentences.zh: 年底，12月29日，是庆祝阿什莉16岁生日的时候了。

sentences.en: Ashley was still grieving.
sentences.zh: 阿什莉仍在悲痛中。

sentences.en: She didn't feel like doing much.
sentences.zh: 她什么都不想做。

sentences.en: She didn't want to party.
sentences.zh: 她不想开派对。

sentences.en: Instead, deciding to spend the day with her mother, Kathy, and of course, Laura.
sentences.zh: 相反，她决定和母亲凯西以及劳拉一起度过这一天。

sentences.en: They went into town.
sentences.zh: 她们进了城。

sentences.en: They went shopping.
sentences.zh: 她们去购物。

sentences.en: They ate.
sentences.zh: 她们吃了饭。

sentences.en: They spent the day together.
sentences.zh: 她们在一起度过了一天。

sentences.en: The girls decided that they wanted to have a sleepover.
sentences.zh: 女孩们决定要举行一场过夜派对。

sentences.en: And so after finishing up in town, they stopped in at Laura's home and she got permission from her parents to sleep over at Ashley's house for her birthday.
sentences.zh: 所以在城里忙完后，她们顺道去了劳拉家，劳拉征得了父母的同意，去阿什莉家过生日。

sentences.en: It was about 7pm.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是晚上7点。

sentences.en: Laura was driving.
sentences.zh: 劳拉在开车。

sentences.en: She was 16.
sentences.zh: 她16岁了。

sentences.en: She had her own car and she drove herself to Ashley's.
sentences.zh: 她有自己的车，自己开车去了阿什莉家。

sentences.en: She also took a purse with her and about $200 in cash.
sentences.zh: 她还带了一个钱包和大约200美元现金。

sentences.en: And so Laura made her way to Ashley's place and they continued the birthday celebrations.
sentences.zh: 于是劳拉前往阿什莉家，她们继续庆祝生日。

sentences.en: All still very low-key.
sentences.zh: 一切都很低调。

sentences.en: They ate cake and they watched a hunting show on TV.
sentences.zh: 她们吃了蛋糕，看了电视上的狩猎节目。

sentences.en: A little while later, Ashley's boyfriend, Jeremy Hurst, turned up and gave Ashley her birthday present.
sentences.zh: 不久后，阿什莉的男友杰里米·赫斯特出现，送给阿什莉生日礼物。

sentences.en: He stayed for a little while before leaving at about 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 他在那儿待了一会儿，大约晚上9点30分离开。

sentences.en: He said everything was normal.
sentences.zh: 他说一切都很正常。

sentences.en: It was a quiet night.
sentences.zh: 那是一个安静的夜晚。

sentences.en: Just Laura and Ashley and Ashley's parents sitting around talking and watching TV.
sentences.zh: 只有劳拉、阿什莉和阿什莉的父母坐在一起聊天看电视。

sentences.en: Nothing crazy going on at all.
sentences.zh: 什么疯狂的事情都没有发生。

sentences.en: Everything appeared normal until about 6am the next morning,
sentences.zh: 一切看起来都很正常，直到第二天清晨6点左右，

sentences.en: Thursday the 30th of December, 1999.
About 6am that next morning, a neighbour of the Freemans called in to report the Freeman trailer was on fire.
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨6点左右，弗里曼家的一位邻居打电话报告说弗里曼家的拖车屋着火了。

sentences.en: It was still dark before sunrise.
sentences.zh: 当时天还没亮，太阳还没升起。

sentences.en: It was a remote, isolated area, so the neighbour wasn't close.
sentences.zh: 那是一个偏远、孤立的地区，所以邻居离得并不近。

sentences.en: But a trailer on fire obviously is hard to miss, even from a long way away.
sentences.zh: 但拖车屋着火显然很难被忽视，即使从很远的地方看也是如此。

sentences.en: Welsh volunteer firefighters rushed to the scene.
sentences.zh: 威尔士志愿消防员赶到了现场。

sentences.en: When they got there, the Freeman trailer was still well alight.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达时，弗里曼家的拖车屋火势依然很猛。

sentences.en: But they managed to put it out.
sentences.zh: 但他们最终还是设法扑灭了大火。

sentences.en: The Craig County Sheriff's Office arrived soon after and a crime scene was established.
sentences.zh: 克雷格县警长办公室不久后赶到，并封锁了犯罪现场。

sentences.en: The area was taped off.
sentences.zh: 该区域被拉上了警戒线。

sentences.en: It was about 7.30am when Lorraine Bible got a phone call that would turn her and her family's life upside down.
sentences.zh: 大约早上7点30分，洛林·拜伯接到了一通电话，这通电话彻底改变了她和家人的生活。

sentences.en: Her son called her at work to tell her the Freeman trailer had been destroyed by fire.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子在上班时打电话告诉她，弗里曼家的拖车屋被火烧毁了。

sentences.en: Pretty much as soon as she hung up, local deputy arrived to tell her the bad news in person and that one body had been located, but he didn't have too much more information.
sentences.zh: 她挂断电话后不久，当地副警长就赶到现场，亲自告诉她这个坏消息，并说已经发现了一具遗体，但他没有更多信息。

sentences.en: Lorraine immediately called her husband and they rushed to the scene.
sentences.zh: 洛林立即打电话给丈夫，他们匆忙赶往现场。

sentences.en: When they got there, still in a state of shock and panic,
sentences.zh: 当他们到达时，依然处于震惊和恐慌之中，

sentences.en: they saw it was taped off and there were a lot of deputies standing around, but no one seemed to be doing too much.
sentences.zh: 他们看到现场被拉上了警戒线，有很多副警长站在周围，但似乎没人做什么。

sentences.en: No one was searching through the debris.
sentences.zh: 没有人搜寻废墟。

sentences.en: The Bibles were panicked and immediately questioned deputies about what they were doing to find their daughter.
sentences.zh: 拜伯夫妇惊慌失措，立即质问副警长们在做什么来寻找他们的女儿。

sentences.en: They were told the investigation would not be starting until an agent arrived from the Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation, otherwise known as the OSBI.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知，调查要等到俄克拉荷马州调查局（简称OSBI）的探员到达后才会开始。

sentences.en: You see, the deputies were well aware of what the Freeman family thought of them after Shane's death and they deemed it to be a conflict of interest for them to investigate.
sentences.zh: 你看，副警长们很清楚弗里曼一家在肖恩死后对他们的看法，他们认为由他们来调查存在利益冲突。

sentences.en: They refused to handle the matter and instead called in the OSBI.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝处理此事，转而请求OSBI介入。

sentences.en: The OSBI is the state law enforcement agency for Oklahoma, independent of the local county departments.
sentences.zh: OSBI是俄克拉荷马州的州级执法机构，独立于当地县级部门。

sentences.en: This decision by Craig County Sheriff's Department may not have been the greatest, as we'll see later.
sentences.zh: 克雷格县警长办公室的这一决定可能并非最佳选择，我们稍后会看到。

sentences.en: The agent from the OSBI who would come to be in charge of the matter was Agent Steve Nutter.
sentences.zh: 负责此事的OSBI探员是史蒂夫·纳特探员。

sentences.en: He arrived at the scene and the investigation commenced.
sentences.zh: 他到达现场，调查随即开始。

sentences.en: The body they had located was identified to be Cathy Freeman.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的遗体被确认为凯西·弗里曼。

sentences.en: And by about 5.30pm that afternoon, they had decided that they had concluded their investigation of the scene, they had collected all the evidence they possibly could,
sentences.zh: 到那天下午5点30分左右，他们决定结束对现场的调查，他们已经收集了所有可能收集到的证据，

sentences.en: and Cathy's body was removed.
sentences.zh: 凯西的遗体被移走。

sentences.en: They told the Bibles that they were 100% sure that there were no other bodies in the house.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉拜伯夫妇，他们百分之百确定屋里没有其他遗体。

sentences.en: As far as the Bibles could see, though, no search was conducted of the 40-acre property the Freemans lived on.
sentences.zh: 然而，据拜伯夫妇所见，并没有对弗里曼一家居住的40英亩土地进行搜查。

sentences.en: The police were only worried about the trailer and the immediate surrounding area.
sentences.zh: 警察只关心拖车屋及其紧邻的区域。

sentences.en: So Laura's father organised a few of the local rangers and they searched some of the property on horseback themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以劳拉的父亲组织了一些当地护林员，他们自己骑马搜寻了部分土地。

sentences.en: But there was no trace of Danny or the girls.
sentences.zh: 但没有丹尼或女孩们的踪迹。

sentences.en: So this raised some serious alarm bells.
sentences.zh: 这敲响了严重的警钟。

sentences.en: Four people went to sleep in the trailer that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上有四个人在拖车屋里睡觉。

sentences.en: Three were unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 三个人下落不明。

sentences.en: Where were Danny, Laura and Ashley?
sentences.zh: 丹尼、劳拉和阿什莉去哪儿了呢？

sentences.en: The Bibles were taken back to the police station where they were interviewed by OSPI agents.
sentences.zh: 圣经（Bible）一家被带回警察局，俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI）的探员在那里对他们进行了问话。

sentences.en: They were interviewed till around midnight.
sentences.zh: 问话一直持续到午夜左右。

sentences.en: Obviously a million things were been running through their minds.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们脑海中闪过了无数个念头。

sentences.en: But the number one thing was that
sentences.zh: 但最主要的一个念头是，

sentences.en: Danny may have killed his wife and abducted the girls.
sentences.zh: 丹尼可能杀害了他的妻子并绑架了女孩们。

sentences.en: That was the only thing making sense at the time.
sentences.zh: 那是当时唯一说得通的解释。

sentences.en: Otherwise, what else could it be?
sentences.zh: 不然还能是什么呢？

sentences.en: There was a problem with that theory, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这个理论有一个问题。

sentences.en: Both Danny and Cathy's cars were still parked in the driveway, as was Laura's car.
sentences.zh: 丹尼和凯西的车都还停在车道上，劳拉的车也是。

sentences.en: It even still had the keys in the ignition.
sentences.zh: 甚至连钥匙都还插在点火开关里。

sentences.en: Remember, this is a remote area and they didn't own any other cars.
sentences.zh: 记住，这是一个偏远地区，他们没有其他车辆。

sentences.en: So how did Danny get away with the girls?
sentences.zh: 那么丹尼是怎么带着女孩们离开的呢？

sentences.en: Loren Bible also informed the OSPI agents that she was aware Danny had a history with drug use and maybe a little bit of drug dealing.
sentences.zh: 洛琳·圣经也告知OSBI探员，她知道丹尼有吸毒史，可能还涉足过一点毒品交易。

sentences.en: This immediately raised the possibility of another scenario.
sentences.zh: 这立即引出了另一种可能的情况。

sentences.en: A drug deal had gone bad.
sentences.zh: 一笔毒品交易出了差错。

sentences.en: It did make sense and it would explain why Danny, Cathy and Laura's cars were still there if someone else had gone there and maybe taken them somewhere.
sentences.zh: 这确实说得通，而且如果是有其他人去过那里并把他们带走了，就能解释为什么丹尼、凯西和劳拉的车还在那里。

sentences.en: The Danny theory and the drug theory.
sentences.zh: 丹尼理论和毒品理论。

sentences.en: These were the two that were making the most sense at the time.
sentences.zh: 这是当时最说得通的两个理论。

sentences.en: Much more sense than the other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 比其他可能性合理得多。

sentences.en: A random attack.
sentences.zh: 随机袭击。

sentences.en: That seemed pretty unlikely.
sentences.zh: 那看起来不太可能。

sentences.en: It was a remote location.
sentences.zh: 那是一个偏远的地方。

sentences.en: What are the chances of someone just stumbling across the Freemans trailer?
sentences.zh: 有人偶然闯入弗里曼家的拖车房的几率有多大？

sentences.en: What about the possibility of the girls being responsible for this?
sentences.zh: 那女孩们对此负责的可能性呢？

sentences.en: Well, that was unimaginable.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是不可想象的。

sentences.en: Not Laura and Ashley.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和阿什利绝不可能。

sentences.en: There's no way they could have done it.
sentences.zh: 她们根本不可能做出这种事。

sentences.en: Early that next morning, the 31st of December,
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨，12月31日，

sentences.en: Agent Nutter received some shocking news.
sentences.zh: 纳特探员收到了一些令人震惊的消息。

sentences.en: Cathy didn't die from the fire.
sentences.zh: 凯西不是死于火灾。

sentences.en: She died from a shotgun blast to the head.
sentences.zh: 她是死于头部遭受的霰弹枪射击。

sentences.en: Her time of death was estimated to be at 5am on the 30th.
sentences.zh: 她的死亡时间估计在30日凌晨5点。

sentences.en: It was also confirmed the fire was deliberately lit and accelerant had been used.
sentences.zh: 此外还证实，火灾是人为纵火，且使用了助燃剂。

sentences.en: Not long after receiving that info, the police got their first tip-off.
sentences.zh: 收到这些信息后不久，警方就接到了第一条线索。

sentences.en: Someone had called in to say that they saw Danny Freeman in a white Ford truck with both Laura and Ashley inside.
sentences.zh: 有人打电话说，他们看到丹尼·弗里曼开着一辆白色福特卡车，车里坐着劳拉和阿什利。

sentences.en: The caller said they saw them about 7am.
sentences.zh: 报案人说他们是在早上7点左右看到的。

sentences.en: So now the police, the Bibles and relatives of the Freeman family thought they had their answer.
sentences.zh: 所以现在警方、圣经一家和弗里曼家族的亲属都认为他们找到了答案。

sentences.en: Danny murdered Cathy,
sentences.zh: 丹尼谋杀了凯西，

sentences.en: set the house on fire and abducted the girls.
sentences.zh: 放火烧了房子，并绑架了女孩们。

sentences.en: Seemed the likely scenario.
sentences.zh: 这看起来是最可能的情况。

sentences.en: But that's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Also, early that morning on the 31st of December, the Bibles returned to the Freeman property.
sentences.zh: 同样是在12月31日那天清晨，圣经一家回到了弗里曼的住所。

sentences.en: It was no longer a crime scene or the police and investigators had gone.
sentences.zh: 那里已经不再是犯罪现场，或者说警察和调查人员已经离开了。

sentences.en: Just imagine what horrible thoughts and feelings they were going through.
sentences.zh: 试想一下他们当时经历了多么可怕的思想斗争和感受。

sentences.en: They went back to the scene just to look around and just in the hope maybe the police missed something.
sentences.zh: 他们回到现场只是为了四处看看，希望能找到警察可能遗漏的东西。

sentences.en: Surely there's got to be a sign of the girls and what happened.
sentences.zh: 肯定会有关于女孩们和所发生之事的线索。

sentences.en: They needed answers.
sentences.zh: 他们需要答案。

sentences.en: They needed to know where their daughter was.
sentences.zh: 他们需要知道女儿在哪里。

sentences.en: Well, they found an answer, all right.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们确实找到了答案。

sentences.en: They found a very big answer.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了一个非常重大的答案。

sentences.en: Not long after arriving at the Freeman property and sifting through the debris, they found the burnt body of Danny Freeman staring back at them.
sentences.zh: 在到达弗里曼住所并翻找废墟后不久，他们就发现了丹尼·弗里曼烧焦的尸体正对着他们。

sentences.en: This was a major, major problem.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常、非常严重的问题。

sentences.en: There was already friction between the Freemans and the local sheriff's department and for that reason, they called in the OSBI to take over of the matter
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家和当地治安官部门之间本就存在摩擦，因此他们叫来了俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI）接手此事，

sentences.en: and to avoid any conflicts of intereSt.
sentences.zh: 以避免任何利益冲突。

sentences.en: But somehow, between them, they managed to miss Danny Freeman's body, which took the Bibles all of about five minutes to find when they started sifting through the debris.
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，他们双方竟然都错过了丹尼·弗里曼的尸体，而圣经一家在开始翻找废墟后，只用了五分钟就发现了它。

sentences.en: Somebody failed miserably.
sentences.zh: 有人严重失职了。

sentences.en: The Bibles called Craig County Sheriff's Office again and they arrived shortly after.
sentences.zh: 圣经一家再次致电克雷格县治安官办公室，他们不久后赶到。

sentences.en: Another crime scene was established and the OSBI was called back in.
sentences.zh: 现场再次被封锁为犯罪现场，OSBI也被重新召回。

sentences.en: The Bibles were told to leave the area because it was a crime scene, but they refused.
sentences.zh: 圣经一家被告知离开该区域，因为这是犯罪现场，但他们拒绝了。

sentences.en: Lorraine raised a good point, saying, we let you do your job yesterday and look how well you did.
sentences.zh: 洛琳提出了一个很好的观点，她说：“我们昨天让你们执行任务，看看你们做得有多好。”

sentences.en: The Bibles weren't going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 圣经一家哪儿也不会去。

sentences.en: Their daughter's body could very well be amongst that debris.
sentences.zh: 他们女儿的尸体很可能就在那些废墟之中。

sentences.en: It was determined soon after that Danny Freeman had also been killed with a shotgun blast to the head.
sentences.zh: 不久后确定，丹尼·弗里曼也是死于头部遭受的霰弹枪射击。

sentences.en: His charred body was found near where his wife's body was found, in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 他烧焦的尸体是在卧室里发现的，就在他妻子尸体被发现的地方附近。

sentences.en: No shotgun was found nearby, ruling out murder-suicide.
sentences.zh: 附近没有发现霰弹枪，排除了谋杀后自杀的可能性。

sentences.en: Now imagine what the Bibles are thinking.
sentences.zh: 现在想象一下圣经一家在想什么。

sentences.en: If the police missed Danny's body, they've probably missed
sentences.zh: 如果警察错过了丹尼的尸体，他们可能也错过了

sentences.en: Laura and Ashley's body as well.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和阿什利的尸体。

sentences.en: An extensive search was carried out of the scene, but by the end of it, the Bibles were told the police were 100% sure there were no other bodies on site.
sentences.zh: 现场进行了大规模搜查，但搜查结束时，圣经一家被告知警方百分之百确定现场没有其他尸体。

sentences.en: I'm not too sure how comforting that was for the Bibles because they had heard that story before.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这对圣经一家来说有多大的安慰，因为他们之前就听过这种说法。

sentences.en: The Bible's grisly discovery had put an end to the theory that Danny had murdered his wife and abducted the girls.
sentences.zh: 圣经一家令人毛骨悚然的发现终结了“丹尼谋杀妻子并绑架女孩”的理论。

sentences.en: And obviously the tip-off the police had received earlier that morning was a false lead.
sentences.zh: 显然，警方当天早些时候收到的线索是一条假线索。

sentences.en: But it now raised the question,
sentences.zh: 但这现在引出了一个问题：

sentences.en: could Laura and Ashley have done this?
sentences.zh: 会不会是劳拉和阿什利干的？

sentences.en: It seemed impossible.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: Two loving, caring girls, good at school, no history of violence, but police had to consider it.
sentences.zh: 两个充满爱心、关心他人的女孩，成绩优异，没有暴力史，但警方不得不考虑这种可能。

sentences.en: Of course there was the same problem as the Danny theory.
sentences.zh: 当然，这和丹尼理论面临同样的问题。

sentences.en: How did they get away?
sentences.zh: 她们是怎么逃走的？

sentences.en: What did they do?
sentences.zh: 她们做了什么？

sentences.en: Murder Danny and Kathy, set the trailer on fire and then run into the woods?
sentences.zh: 谋杀丹尼和凯西，放火烧了拖车房，然后跑进树林？

sentences.en: All the cars were still in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 所有的车都还停在车道上。

sentences.en: Laura's purse was found at the scene, still had the money in it and her ID.
sentences.zh: 劳拉的钱包在现场被发现，里面还有钱和她的身份证件。

sentences.en: Nothing was adding up.
sentences.zh: 一切都对不上号。

sentences.en: The only thing that made sense if Laura and Ashley were responsible was that it was self-defense.
sentences.zh: 如果劳拉和阿什利要负责，唯一说得通的就是正当防卫。

sentences.en: What if Danny and Kathy had gotten into an argument,
sentences.zh: 如果丹尼和凯西发生了争吵，

sentences.en: Danny had shot Kathy, then Ashley, defending her mother, shot Danny?
sentences.zh: 丹尼开枪打死了凯西，然后阿什利为了保护母亲，开枪打死了丹尼呢？

sentences.en: Ashley was an avid hunter and she had her own guns.
sentences.zh: 阿什利是一位狂热的猎人，她有自己的枪。

sentences.en: It still seemed crazy, but it had to be considered.
sentences.zh: 这看起来仍然很疯狂，但必须予以考虑。

sentences.en: As the investigation continued, police learnt that Danny had a large gun collection himself, rifles and shotguns.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的继续，警方了解到丹尼本人收藏了大量枪支，包括步枪和霰弹枪。

sentences.en: There were around 14 found at the scene.
sentences.zh: 现场发现了大约14支。

sentences.en: But they wouldn't say if the murder weapon was among them.
sentences.zh: 但他们不愿透露凶器是否在其中。

sentences.en: Police also learnt that Ashley had close to $4,000 in cash saved up, hidden in the freezer.
sentences.zh: 警方还了解到，阿什利存了近4000美元现金，藏在冰箱里。

sentences.en: That was the money she was going to use to buy her car.
sentences.zh: 那是她打算用来买车的钱。

sentences.en: But that money was gone.
sentences.zh: 但那笔钱不见了。

sentences.en: There was no sign of it.
sentences.zh: 没有任何痕迹。

sentences.en: Someone who knew it was there had taken it.
sentences.zh: 知道钱在那里的人把它拿走了。

sentences.en: The Freeman family,
sentences.zh: 弗里曼家族，

sentences.en: Ashley's uncle and grandmother, had their own theory which was pretty bizarre.
sentences.zh: 阿什利的叔叔和祖母，有他们自己的理论，这非常离奇。

sentences.en: They were convinced the local sheriff's department was responsible, finally putting an end to the bitter feud they had been having with the family since Shane's death.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信是当地治安官部门干的，最终结束了他们自肖恩去世以来与该家族之间激烈的宿怨。

sentences.en: Danny's brother even said that just prior to his death,
sentences.zh: 丹尼的兄弟甚至说，就在他去世前不久，

sentences.en: Danny had an animated discussion with him and said, if anything ever happens to me, look at the sheriff's department.
sentences.zh: 丹尼曾与他进行过激烈的讨论，并说：“如果我出了什么事，去查治安官部门。”

sentences.en: Danny's brother said
sentences.zh: 丹尼的兄弟说，

sentences.en: Danny was deadly serious when he said this, pointing finger in his face.
sentences.zh: 丹尼说这话时神情极其严肃，指着他的脸。

sentences.en: Obviously Danny could easily have just been letting off steam by saying this, being a bit worked up in a heated discussion.
sentences.zh: 显然，丹尼可能只是在激烈的讨论中情绪激动，发泄一下不满而已。

sentences.en: Tensions were high with the sheriff's department and it could be a natural thing to say.
sentences.zh: 与治安官部门的关系本来就很紧张，说这种话是很自然的。

sentences.en: It then came out that the Freeman family were actually trying to save enough money to file a wrongful death suit in relation to Shane's death.
sentences.zh: 后来有消息称，弗里曼一家实际上正在努力存钱，准备就肖恩的死提起非正常死亡诉讼。

sentences.en: They only had one week left to come up with the money to file the suit, otherwise a year would have passed since Shane's death and they would no longer be able to file.
sentences.zh: 他们只剩下一周的时间来筹集诉讼费，否则肖恩去世就满一年了，他们将无法再提起诉讼。

sentences.en: Danny's brother said the local deputies were trying to threaten and intimidate Danny Freeman not to go ahead with the case.
sentences.zh: 丹尼的兄弟说，当地副警长曾试图威胁和恐吓丹尼·弗里曼，让他不要继续打官司。

sentences.en: The Freemans wouldn't drop this theory and were convinced the local deputies had killed Danny and Kathy and buried the girl somewhere.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家不愿放弃这个理论，坚信是当地副警长杀了丹尼和凯西，并把女孩埋在了某个地方。

sentences.en: The OSBI responded and put the local deputies on a lie detector test, all passed with flying colours.
sentences.zh: OSBI做出了回应，让当地副警长接受了测谎仪测试，所有人都顺利通过了。

sentences.en: Agent Steve Nutter had this to say,
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·纳特探员这样说道：

sentences.en: all cleared themselves as a result of those examinations.
sentences.zh: “由于这些检查，所有人都洗清了嫌疑。”

sentences.en: The overall conclusion of our efforts was that the Sheriff's Office had nothing to do with the murders of Danny and Kathy and did not know the whereabouts of the two missing girls.
sentences.zh: “我们调查的最终结论是，治安官办公室与丹尼和凯西的谋杀案无关，也不知道两个失踪女孩的下落。”

sentences.en: It's a pretty far reach to think that local deputies could have murdered
sentences.zh: 认为当地副警长可能因为一起非正常死亡诉讼而谋杀

sentences.en: Danny and Kathy and then abducted the two girls over a wrongful death suit.
sentences.zh: 丹尼和凯西，然后绑架了两个女孩，这有点太牵强了。

sentences.en: Wrongful death suits are nothing new to police departments and the death had already been ruled justifiable at the time by the district attorney.
sentences.zh: 非正常死亡诉讼对警察部门来说并不新鲜，而且当时地方检察官已经裁定那起死亡事件是正当的。

sentences.en: It seems a bit of a stretch.
sentences.zh: 这似乎有点勉强。

sentences.en: Clearly there was friction there and naturally the remaining members of the Freeman family are going to look to put some blame on the local deputies.
sentences.zh: 显然那里存在摩擦，弗里曼家族剩下的成员自然会试图将一些责任归咎于当地副警长。

sentences.en: The information received that the Freemans were trying to come up with enough money to file a wrongful death claim was interesting.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼一家正在努力筹钱提起非正常死亡索赔的信息很有意思。

sentences.en: It was found out that that amount of money they needed was $5,000, a pretty significant sum to come up with in one week.
sentences.zh: 据了解，他们需要的金额是5000美元，在一周内筹集到这笔钱是一笔不小的数目。

sentences.en: It's already been mentioned that Danny was known to be involved in drugs and maybe a little bit of dealing.
sentences.zh: 之前已经提到，丹尼以涉毒和可能进行少量毒品交易而闻名。

sentences.en: Could he have gone in over his head looking for a big quick payday only to have the big deal go horribly wrong?
sentences.zh: 他会不会是因为想快速赚大钱而陷入困境，结果导致大交易出了严重差错？

sentences.en: It was certainly possible.
sentences.zh: 这当然是有可能的。

sentences.en: Or was it?
sentences.zh: 或者真的是这样吗？

sentences.en: The OSBI didn't seem to think so.
sentences.zh: OSBI似乎并不这么认为。

sentences.en: Agent Nutter thought that nothing fit correctly if it was drug related and that the very last thing anyone would want to do is abduct the two girls if it was a drug matter.
sentences.zh: 纳特探员认为，如果是毒品相关案件，没有任何线索能完全吻合，而且如果是毒品问题，任何人最不想做的事就是绑架这两个女孩。

sentences.en: Now he's privy to information that we aren't but that's an incredible comment.
